newsitem.title: UK: BMP DDB wins Easy Jeans 2 mln stg advertising acct.
newsitem.headline: BMP DDB wins Easy Jeans 2 mln stg advertising acct.

text.p: BMP DDB on Monday said it was awarded Easy Jeans' two million pound advertising account after winning a four-way pitch against Mellors Reay and Partners, BST-BDDT, and Branded.
Duckworth Finn Grubb Waters previously held the Easy Jeans account, but the brand has not been advertised in the UK for a number of years.

"We were looking for an agency to relaunch the brand," Simon Edwards, brand manager at Easy Jeans, said in a statement. "The creative output and strategy BMP DDB presented to us combines impact and style, which will be flexible across a range of media."
Easy Jeans holds a five percent share in the UK jeans market.

"Easy Jeans offer high quality, realistically priced fashion products with broad appeal," Richard Morris, account direct at BMP DDB, said. "Our advertising will reflect these values and give Easy Jeans a real attitude."
BMP DDB, which will also handle media for Easy Jeans, will unveil the ad campaign in the spring.
